rubric: Judge safe focused correction toward the visible boss, accounting for drift and delay; do not require one fixed move.
Keep shooting; assess overshoot across the whole maneuver.
Compare chronological diamond motion against the player and planned path over the historical delay.
A clear-looking present gap is not enough; assess whether it stays open.
Decide whether the approaching stream threatens the delayed position before making a small tracking correction.
Standing still, a short focused dodge, or a proactive bomb can be defensible if visually justified.
Infer boss drift or possible reversal from all three original frames; avoid stale pursuit.
Compare a short focused adjustment with holding fire from current alignment.
Already nearly aligned: holding position while firing is a valid candidate if no delayed threat crosses it.
Do not reward motion merely for being short; useful damage and safety matter.
Large horizontal separation allows several safe corrections; compare small focused nudge against adequate progress.
Read remaining resources from HUD; do not use a bomb solely for being displaced.
Friendly colored orbiting bomb balls are not enemy beads; ground player from the newest screenshot or report null if obscured.
Do not substitute an older firing-column position.
Read visible HUD bomb availability; do not rely on unavailable X.
Use the newest player evidence during friendly effects; choose a defensible path rather than a single gold action.
